caption: The drawing features a detailed colored depiction of a bonnet or cap, with the main section rendered in a blue-green color, segmented by darker blue lines suggesting stitching or gathered fabric sections. The inner lining of the bonnet is shown in a textured, diamond-patterned red color, and it extends outward to form a thick pink border. Two pink fabric ties hang down from the bottom edge of the bonnet. To the right of the main image, there are two smaller, uncolored line-drawings of the same bonnet, one above the other, showing front and back views of the object with simplified seam and structure outlines. The entire composition is enclosed within a faintly drawn rectangular border, and a signature, "R. Mayuetti," appears at the bottom right within the border. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Opera Hood
